justification.text: 2 ≤ #X is the problem's n ≥ 2 (inclusive), which the informal text states explicitly: a line through two points of X needs two points.

imbalance X p q ≤ 100 is the problem's 'the numbers of points on either side of ℓ differ by at most 100' (inclusive): imbalance is the absolute difference of the two side counts (defs/Local.lean), and 'at most 100' is ≤ 100.

/-! Non-vacuity witness (D-4 step 7): the two-point set {(0,0), (1,1)} has two elements. -/

theorem witness : ∃ (X : Finset (ℝ × ℝ)), (2 : ℕ) ≤ Finset.card X :=
  ⟨{((0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)), (1, 1)}, (Finset.card_pair (by simp)).ge⟩
